definitions: An island of Japan in the Korea Strait, between Kyushu and South Korea.
A city located on Tsushima Island, Japan.
The Battle of Tsushima, a major naval battle fought in 1905 during the Russo-Japanese War.
examples: Tsushima is known for its unique wildlife.
The ferry to Tsushima departs daily.
The Battle of Tsushima was a decisive victory for Japan.
